page.overview:
Who is Army Pilot 1?

Army Pilot 1 is a military pilot in Springfield. When Groundskeeper Willie fires a gun to try to destroy Skinner's Weather Balloon, his plane mis-attributes the attack as coming from an Iraqi fighter jet. He fires at a missile at the supposed fighter jet, but it hits the plane with Army Pilot 2 and Army Pilot 3 instead. He fires one more missile, which destroys his own jet.
